ExecutableModel::ExecutableModel(AnyAsyncValueRef chain,
                                 AnyAsyncValueRef mgpContext,
                                 AnyAsyncValueRef weightsRegistry,
                                 SmallVector<AnyAsyncValueRef> &&extraArgs,
                                 const Model *model, CPUDevice &cpuDevice)
    : model(model), cpuDevice(cpuDevice), chain(std::move(chain)),
      mgpContext(std::move(mgpContext)),
      weightsRegistry(std::move(weightsRegistry)),
      extraArgs(std::move(extraArgs)) {}

ExecutableModel::~ExecutableModel() = default;

SmallVector<AnyAsyncValueRef>
ExecutableModel::execute(MutableArrayRef<AnyAsyncValueRef> args) const {
  TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NC("ExecutableModel::execute", TRACY_COLOR_TEAL);

  checkUniqueCPUDevice(getCPUDevice());

  // Fixed args (chain, context, weights registry), devices, init->exec context
  // bundles, then inputs. See ModelOp in MGPOps.td.
  SmallVector<AnyAsyncValueRef> passedArgs;
  passedArgs.reserve(kMgpModelNumFixedImplicitExecArgs + extraArgs.size() +
                     args.size());
  passedArgs.emplace_back(chain.copy());
  passedArgs.emplace_back(mgpContext.copy());
  passedArgs.emplace_back(weightsRegistry.copy());
  for (const AnyAsyncValueRef &dev : extraArgs)
    passedArgs.emplace_back(dev.copy());
  for (AnyAsyncValueRef &arg : args)
    passedArgs.emplace_back(std::move(arg));

  // Some kernels read the thread-local cpuDevice.
  AsyncRT::CompactCPUDevicePtr::setCurrentCPUDevice(getCPUDevice());

  return getModel()->getExecuteFn()->invoke(passedArgs, getCPUDevice());
}

ErrorOrSuccess ExecutableModel::waitForModelSetup() {
  AsyncRT::await({chain.copy(), mgpContext.copy(), weightsRegistry.copy()});
  AsyncRT::await(extraArgs);
  if (chain.isError())
    return Error(chain.takeDiagnostic().getMessage().get());
  if (mgpContext.isError())
    return Error(mgpContext.takeDiagnostic().getMessage().get());
  if (weightsRegistry.isError())
    return Error(weightsRegistry.takeDiagnostic().getMessage().get());
  for (auto &arg : extraArgs) {
    if (arg.isError())
      return Error(arg.takeDiagnostic().getMessage().get());
  }
  return success();
}

// Pinned host memory or a CPU context. Mirrors GenericML DeviceMemory::isHost.
static bool isHostResident(const Driver::DeviceBufferRef &buffer) {
  return buffer->isHost() ||
         buffer->context().device().api() == Driver::Device::cpuAPI;
}

// Stable hash of (index, address, shape, dtype) over the non-host inputs on
// this device only, so replay can mix device keys from different captures.
static uint64_t computeInputKeyForDevice(ArrayRef<ModelInputBuffer> inputs,
                                         const Driver::Device &device) {
  raw_xxhash64_stream hasher;

  uint64_t deviceId = static_cast<uint64_t>(device.id());
  hasher.write(reinterpret_cast<const char *>(&deviceId), sizeof(deviceId));

  for (size_t inputIndex = 0; inputIndex < inputs.size(); ++inputIndex) {
    const ModelInputBuffer &input = inputs[inputIndex];
    if (isHostResident(input.buffer))
      continue;

    const Driver::Device &inputDevice = input.buffer->context().device();
    if (inputDevice.id() != device.id() || inputDevice.api() != device.api())
      continue;

    uint64_t stableInputIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(inputIndex);
    hasher.write(reinterpret_cast<const char *>(&stableInputIndex),
                 sizeof(stableInputIndex));

    void *bufferAddress = input.buffer->ptr();
    hasher.write(reinterpret_cast<const char *>(&bufferAddress),
                 sizeof(bufferAddress));

    const TensorSpec &spec = input.spec;
    uint64_t rank = spec.getRank();
    hasher.write(reinterpret_cast<const char *>(&rank), sizeof(rank));
    for (int64_t dim : spec)
      hasher.write(reinterpret_cast<const char *>(&dim), sizeof(dim));

    uint64_t dtype = static_cast<uint64_t>(spec.getEltType().getValue());
    hasher.write(reinterpret_cast<const char *>(&dtype), sizeof(dtype));
  }
  return hasher.hash();
}

static SmallVector<uint64_t>
computePerDeviceInputSignatures(ArrayRef<ModelInputBuffer> inputs,
                                ArrayRef<Driver::DeviceStreamRef> streams) {
  SmallVector<uint64_t> signatures;
  signatures.reserve(streams.size());
  for (const Driver::DeviceStreamRef &stream : streams)
    signatures.push_back(computeInputKeyForDevice(inputs, stream->device()));
  return signatures;
}

static std::string graphKeysToString(ArrayRef<uint64_t> graphKeys);

static ErrorOr<SmallVector<uint64_t>>
normalizeGraphKeysForDevices(ArrayRef<uint64_t> graphKeys, size_t deviceCount,
                             StringRef operationName) {
  if (deviceCount == 0)
    return Error("No graph-capture devices available for this model");

  if (graphKeys.empty())
    return Error(Twine("graph keys must not be empty for ") + operationName);

  if (graphKeys.size() == 1 && deviceCount > 1)
    return SmallVector<uint64_t>(deviceCount, graphKeys.front());

  if (graphKeys.size() != deviceCount) {
    std::string keysString = graphKeysToString(graphKeys);
    return Error(Twine("per-device graph key count mismatch for ") +
                 operationName + ": got " + Twine(graphKeys.size()) + " keys " +
                 keysString + ", expected " + Twine(deviceCount));
  }

  return SmallVector<uint64_t>(graphKeys.begin(), graphKeys.end());
}

static std::string graphKeysToString(ArrayRef<uint64_t> graphKeys) {
  std::string out;
  llvm::raw_string_ostream os(out);
  os << "[";
  llvm::interleaveComma(graphKeys, os);
  os << "]";
  return os.str();
}

// Graph-capture-capable streams of the model's device contexts, so
// capture/replay use the same devices as execution.
static ErrorOr<SmallVector<Driver::DeviceStreamRef>>
captureStreams(MutableArrayRef<AnyAsyncValueRef> extraArgs) {
  if (auto err = AsyncRT::awaitOrError(extraArgs))
    return err.takeError();

  SmallVector<Driver::DeviceStreamRef> results;
  for (const AnyAsyncValueRef &arg : extraArgs) {
    M::RCRef<M::Driver::DeviceContext> *context =
        dyn_cast<Driver::DeviceContextRef>(arg);
    if (!context)
      continue;

    assert(context->getPointer() != nullptr &&
           "captureStreams: DeviceContextRef holds a null pointer — "
           "was mapDeviceRefsToDevices called correctly?");
    Driver::Device::API api = context->getPointer()->device().api();
    if (api != Driver::Device::cudaAPI && api != Driver::Device::hipAPI)
      continue;

    ErrorOr<Driver::DeviceStreamRef> streamOr = context->getPointer()->stream();
    if (streamOr.isError())
      return streamOr.takeError();

    results.push_back(streamOr.takeValue());
  }

  return results;
}

ErrorOr<SmallVector<AnyAsyncValueRef>>
ExecutableModel::executeWithInputs(ArrayRef<ModelInputBuffer> inputs) const {
  SmallVector<AnyAsyncValueRef> inputValues;
  inputValues.reserve(inputs.size());
  for (const ModelInputBuffer &input : inputs) {
    inputValues.push_back(GraphCompiler::Driver::prepareInput(
        getCPUDevice(), input.buffer, input.spec));
  }

  SmallVector<AnyAsyncValueRef> results = execute(inputValues);
  if (auto err = AsyncRT::awaitOrError(results))
    return err.takeError();

  return results;
}

ErrorOr<SmallVector<AnyAsyncValueRef>>
ExecutableModel::capture(ArrayRef<uint64_t> graphKeys,
                         ArrayRef<ModelInputBuffer> inputs) {
  ErrorOr<SmallVector<Driver::DeviceStreamRef>> streamsOr =
      captureStreams(extraArgs);

  if (streamsOr.isError())
    return streamsOr.takeError();

  const size_t deviceCount = streamsOr->size();

  ErrorOr<SmallVector<uint64_t>> normalizedKeysOr =
      normalizeGraphKeysForDevices(graphKeys, deviceCount, "capture");
  if (normalizedKeysOr.isError())
    return normalizedKeysOr.takeError();
  ArrayRef<uint64_t> normalizedKeys = *normalizedKeysOr;

  if (perDeviceGraphs.empty())
    perDeviceGraphs.resize(deviceCount);
  else if (perDeviceGraphs.size() != deviceCount)
    return Error(Twine("capture device count changed from ") +
                 Twine(perDeviceGraphs.size()) + " to " + Twine(deviceCount));

  bool anyDeviceHit = false;
  for (size_t deviceIdx = 0; deviceIdx < deviceCount; ++deviceIdx) {
    if (perDeviceGraphs[deviceIdx].contains(normalizedKeys[deviceIdx])) {
      anyDeviceHit = true;
      break;
    }
  }

  if (anyDeviceHit) {
    std::string keysString = graphKeysToString(normalizedKeys);
    return Error(Twine("Graph keys already captured for capture: ") +
                 keysString + ". Use replay() for existing keys.");
  }

  // Only for per-device graph-key safety validation.
  SmallVector<uint64_t> inputSignatures =
      computePerDeviceInputSignatures(inputs, *streamsOr);

  SmallVector<AnyAsyncValueRef> graphResults;

  ErrorOr<Driver::DeviceGraphCollection> graphOrErr =
      Driver::DeviceGraph::capture(
          cpuDevice, *streamsOr, [&]() -> ErrorOrSuccess {
            auto maybeResult = executeWithInputs(inputs);
            if (maybeResult.isError())
              return maybeResult.takeError();

            graphResults = maybeResult.takeValue();
            return success();
          });

  if (graphOrErr.isError())
    return Error(Twine("Failed to capture graph: ") + graphOrErr.getError());

  // Don't propagate yet: materialize capture results before extracting the
  // graphs, even on error.
  ErrorOrSuccess err = AsyncRT::awaitOrError(graphResults);

  if (err.isError())
    return err.takeError();

  Driver::DeviceGraphCollection graphs = graphOrErr.takeValue();

  ArrayRef<Driver::AsyncDeviceGraphRef> capturedGraphs = graphs.getGraphs();
  if (capturedGraphs.size() != deviceCount) {
    return Error(Twine("captured graph count mismatch: expected ") +
                 Twine(deviceCount) + ", got " + Twine(capturedGraphs.size()));
  }

  for (size_t deviceIdx = 0; deviceIdx < deviceCount; ++deviceIdx) {
    CapturedPerDeviceGraphEntry entry;
    entry.graph = capturedGraphs[deviceIdx].copy();
    entry.inputSignature = inputSignatures[deviceIdx];
    perDeviceGraphs[deviceIdx].try_emplace(normalizedKeys[deviceIdx],
                                           std::move(entry));
  }

  return graphResults;
}

ErrorOrSuccess ExecutableModel::validateCapturedPerDeviceKeys(
    ArrayRef<uint64_t> graphKeys) const {
  if (perDeviceGraphs.size() != graphKeys.size()) {
    return Error(Twine("capture device count changed from ") +
                 Twine(perDeviceGraphs.size()) + " to " +
                 Twine(graphKeys.size()));
  }

  for (size_t deviceIdx = 0; deviceIdx < graphKeys.size(); ++deviceIdx) {
    const auto &deviceMap = perDeviceGraphs[deviceIdx];
    auto it = deviceMap.find(graphKeys[deviceIdx]);
    if (it == deviceMap.end()) {
      return Error(Twine("No captured graph for device ") + Twine(deviceIdx) +
                   " key " + Twine(graphKeys[deviceIdx]));
    }
  }

  return success();
}

ErrorOrSuccess ExecutableModel::validateCapturedPerDeviceEntries(
    ArrayRef<uint64_t> graphKeys, ArrayRef<uint64_t> inputSignatures) const {
  if (ErrorOrSuccess err = validateCapturedPerDeviceKeys(graphKeys))
    return err.takeError();

  if (inputSignatures.size() != graphKeys.size()) {
    return Error(Twine("input signature count mismatch: expected ") +
                 Twine(graphKeys.size()) + ", got " +
                 Twine(inputSignatures.size()));
  }

  for (size_t deviceIdx = 0; deviceIdx < graphKeys.size(); ++deviceIdx) {
    const auto &deviceMap = perDeviceGraphs[deviceIdx];
    auto it = deviceMap.find(graphKeys[deviceIdx]);
    ASSERT_STREAM(it != deviceMap.end(), "expected captured graph entry");

    if (it->second.inputSignature != inputSignatures[deviceIdx]) {
      return Error(Twine("Unsafe graph key reuse on device ") +
                   Twine(deviceIdx) + " for key " +
                   Twine(graphKeys[deviceIdx]) + ": expected input signature " +
                   Twine(it->second.inputSignature) + ", got " +
                   Twine(inputSignatures[deviceIdx]) +
                   ". Use distinct caller-provided keys for distinct input "
                   "buffer/signature configurations.");
    }
  }

  return success();
}

// The gate for the backend this model runs on, or null if it has none. A host
// context has no gate, so take the first context that does; the accelerators
// share one driver.
static Driver::KernelLoadGate *
kernelLoadGateFor(ArrayRef<AsyncRT::AnyAsyncValueRef> extraArgs) {
  for (const AsyncRT::AnyAsyncValueRef &arg : extraArgs) {
    auto *ctxRef = dyn_cast<Driver::DeviceContextRef>(arg);
    if (ctxRef == nullptr || ctxRef->getPointer() == nullptr)
      continue;
    if (Driver::KernelLoadGate *gate = (*ctxRef)->kernelLoadGate())
      return gate;
  }
  return nullptr;
}

// Like MLRT::launchDeviceCollective, but dispatches only once the collective
// owns `gate`, and releases it when the last element has run. The caller holds
// nothing while it awaits the result, since a task the wait runs may need the
// gate.
template <typename ElementFn>
static AsyncRT::AsyncValueRef<AsyncRT::Chain>
launchGatedDeviceCollective(AsyncRT::CPUDevice &cpuDevice,
                            Driver::KernelLoadGate *gate, size_t count,
                            ElementFn elementFn) {
  auto dispatch = [&cpuDevice, gate, count,
                   elementFn = std::move(elementFn)]() mutable {
    AsyncRT::AsyncValueRef<AsyncRT::Chain> fanout =
        MLRT::launchDeviceCollective(cpuDevice, count, std::move(elementFn));
    if (gate != nullptr)
      fanout.andThenSync([gate] { gate->releaseCollective(); });
    return fanout;
  };

  AsyncRT::AsyncValueRef<AsyncRT::Chain> grant;
  if (gate == nullptr || gate->tryAcquireCollective(cpuDevice, grant))
    return dispatch();

  auto done = AsyncRT::AsyncValueRef<AsyncRT::Chain>::allocate(cpuDevice);
  grant.andThenAsync(
      [dispatch = std::move(dispatch), done = done.copy()]() mutable {
        AsyncRT::AsyncValueRef<AsyncRT::Chain> fanout = dispatch();
        fanout.andThenSync(
            [done = std::move(done)]() mutable { std::move(done).emplace(); });
      });
  return done;
}

ErrorOrSuccess
ExecutableModel::launchDeviceGraphs(ArrayRef<uint64_t> normalizedKeys) const {
  if (normalizedKeys.empty())
    return success();

  SmallVector<ErrorOrSuccess, 8> errors(normalizedKeys.size());

  SmallVector<const CapturedPerDeviceGraphEntry *, 8> entries(
      normalizedKeys.size());
  for (size_t deviceIdx = 0; deviceIdx < normalizedKeys.size(); ++deviceIdx) {
    const auto &deviceMap = perDeviceGraphs[deviceIdx];
    auto it = deviceMap.find(normalizedKeys[deviceIdx]);
    ASSERT_STREAM(it != deviceMap.end(), "expected captured graph entry");
    entries[deviceIdx] = &it->second;
  }

  // Await every graph before any of them replays, so the replays themselves
  // never wait: a graph that never materializes would otherwise leave the
  // peers that did replay spinning at a barrier it will never reach.
  for (size_t deviceIdx = 0; deviceIdx < entries.size(); ++deviceIdx) {
    if (ErrorOrSuccess err = AsyncRT::awaitOrError(entries[deviceIdx]->graph))
      return err.takeError();
  }

  auto launchGraph = [&](size_t deviceIdx) {
    if (ErrorOrSuccess err = (*entries[deviceIdx]->graph)->replay())
      errors[deviceIdx] = err.takeError();
  };

  // A captured graph can contain collective kernels, so the gate keeps kernel
  // loads out until every replay has launched; see Driver::KernelLoadGate. A
  // single graph has no peers to strand, so it skips the gate.
  if (normalizedKeys.size() == 1) {
    launchGraph(0);
  } else {
    // launchGraph captures this frame by reference, which is sound because
    // this frame outlives the await even when a task the await runs buries it.
    AsyncRT::await(launchGatedDeviceCollective(
        cpuDevice, kernelLoadGateFor(extraArgs), normalizedKeys.size(),
        std::move(launchGraph)));
  }

  for (ErrorOrSuccess &err : errors) {
    if (err)
      return err.takeError();
  }

  return success();
}

ErrorOrSuccess ExecutableModel::replay(ArrayRef<uint64_t> graphKeys,
                                       ArrayRef<ModelInputBuffer> inputs) {
  ErrorOr<SmallVector<Driver::DeviceStreamRef>> streamsOr =
      captureStreams(extraArgs);

  if (streamsOr.isError())
    return streamsOr.takeError();

  ErrorOr<SmallVector<uint64_t>> normalizedKeysOr =
      normalizeGraphKeysForDevices(graphKeys, streamsOr->size(), "replay");
  if (normalizedKeysOr.isError())
    return normalizedKeysOr.takeError();
  ArrayRef<uint64_t> normalizedKeys = *normalizedKeysOr;

  SmallVector<uint64_t> inputSignatures =
      computePerDeviceInputSignatures(inputs, *streamsOr);

  if (ErrorOrSuccess err =
          validateCapturedPerDeviceEntries(normalizedKeys, inputSignatures))
    return err.takeError();

  return launchDeviceGraphs(normalizedKeys);
}

ErrorOrSuccess
ExecutableModel::debugVerifyReplay(ArrayRef<uint64_t> graphKeys,
                                   ArrayRef<ModelInputBuffer> inputs) {
  ErrorOr<SmallVector<Driver::DeviceStreamRef>> streamsOr =
      captureStreams(extraArgs);

  if (streamsOr.isError())
    return streamsOr.takeError();

  ErrorOr<SmallVector<uint64_t>> normalizedKeysOr =
      normalizeGraphKeysForDevices(graphKeys, streamsOr->size(),
                                   "debug verify replay");
  if (normalizedKeysOr.isError())
    return normalizedKeysOr.takeError();
  ArrayRef<uint64_t> normalizedKeys = *normalizedKeysOr;

  // This validates eager launch traces, not replay safety, so non-capture
  // input signatures are allowed.
  if (ErrorOrSuccess err = validateCapturedPerDeviceKeys(normalizedKeys))
    return err.takeError();

  SmallVector<Driver::AsyncDeviceGraphRef> selectedGraphs;
  selectedGraphs.reserve(normalizedKeys.size());
  for (size_t deviceIdx = 0; deviceIdx < normalizedKeys.size(); ++deviceIdx) {
    const auto &deviceMap = perDeviceGraphs[deviceIdx];
    auto it = deviceMap.find(normalizedKeys[deviceIdx]);
    ASSERT_STREAM(it != deviceMap.end(), "expected captured graph entry");

    selectedGraphs.push_back(it->second.graph.copy());
  }

  Driver::DeviceGraphCollection graphs(std::move(selectedGraphs));
  return graphs.debugVerifyReplay([&]() -> ErrorOrSuccess {
    auto result = executeWithInputs(inputs);
    if (result.isError())
      return result.takeError();
    return success();
  });
}

ErrorOrSuccess ExecutableModel::awaitDeviceGraphs() {
  for (auto &deviceMap : perDeviceGraphs) {
    for (auto &[key, entry] : deviceMap) {
      if (ErrorOrSuccess err = AsyncRT::awaitOrError(entry.graph))
        return err.takeError();
    }
  }
  return success();
}

ErrorOrSuccess
ExecutableModel::releaseCapturedGraphs(ArrayRef<uint64_t> graphKeys) {
  // Releasing on a model with no captures yet is a no-op for every key.
  if (perDeviceGraphs.empty())
    return success();

  // Count devices from the live capture streams, not perDeviceGraphs.size(),
  // so key-count errors match capture/replay/debugVerifyReplay.
  ErrorOr<SmallVector<Driver::DeviceStreamRef>> streamsOr =
      captureStreams(extraArgs);
  if (streamsOr.isError())
    return streamsOr.takeError();

  ErrorOr<SmallVector<uint64_t>> normalizedKeysOr =
      normalizeGraphKeysForDevices(graphKeys, streamsOr->size(), "release");
  if (normalizedKeysOr.isError())
    return normalizedKeysOr.takeError();
  ArrayRef<uint64_t> normalizedKeys = *normalizedKeysOr;

  for (size_t deviceIdx = 0; deviceIdx < normalizedKeys.size(); ++deviceIdx)
    perDeviceGraphs[deviceIdx].erase(normalizedKeys[deviceIdx]);

  return success();
}

ErrorOrSuccess ExecutableModel::printValue(raw_ostream &os,
                                           AnyAsyncValueRef const &value,
                                           ResultOutputStyle style,
                                           unsigned precision) const {
  return GML::printGenericValue(os, value, style, precision);
}

ErrorOrSuccess
ExecutableModel::processResultForBinaryOutput(const AnyAsyncValueRef &result,
                                              const std::string &outputName,
                                              ProcessedResults &results) const {
  if (auto *tensor = dyn_cast<Tensor>(result)) {
    results.insertResultInfo(
        std::make_shared<TensorResultInfo>(outputName, *tensor));

    const std::string illegalChars = "\\/:?\"<>|";
    std::string sanitizedName = outputName;
    std::replace_if(
        sanitizedName.begin(), sanitizedName.end(),
        [&](char c) { return illegalChars.find(c) != std::string::npos; }, '_');

    results.insertTensor(sanitizedName, tensor);
  } else {
    ErrorOr<AsyncRT::AnyAsyncValueRef> outOrError =
        M::getResultForBinaryOutput(result, results);
    if (outOrError.isError())
      results.insertResultInfo(
          std::make_shared<TensorResultInfo>(outOrError.getError(), ""));
    else
      results.insertResultInfo(std::make_shared<M::VariantResultInfo>(
          outputName, outOrError.takeValue()));
  }
  return success();
}

ErrorOr<ModelList> M::loadMGPMEFFile(RCRef<MEFFile> mefFile) {
  PrimitiveRegistry primitives;
  registerAllGraphRTPrimitives(primitives);
  registerMGPPrimitives(primitives);
  primitives.finalize();

  if (auto err = mefFile->installPrimitives(primitives))
    return err.takeError();

  ModelList models;
  auto *moduleInv = mefFile->getTopLevelInvokable();
  if (auto err = moduleInv->walkPrimitives<Model>(
          [&](auto &&m) { models.push_back(std::forward<decltype(m)>(m)); }))
    return err.takeError();

  return std::move(models);
}

/// Indicates that a work item has no device preference for execution.
static constexpr int kNoDevicePreference = -1;

/// Fulfills the result with a StateContext initialized with `numPrimContexts`
/// primitive contexts.
static void mgp_context_create(Result<StateContext> result,
                               MEFAttr<uint64_t> numSlots) {
  std::move(result).emplace(*numSlots);
}

/// Packs pointers to the input and output async values (then the constant
/// resources) into the array the kernel ABI expects.
template <typename OperandTy, typename ResultTy>
llvm::SmallVector<void *> getKernelInputs(OperandTy &operands,
                                          ResultTy &results,
                                          MEFListAttr constantResources) {
  TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NC("getKernelInputs", TRACY_COLOR_TEAL);

  llvm::SmallVector<void *> kernelInputs;
  kernelInputs.reserve(results.size() + operands.size() +
                       constantResources.size());

  auto appendInput = [&kernelInputs](const AnyAsyncValueRef &ref) {
    kernelInputs.push_back(
        const_cast<void *>(reinterpret_cast<const void *>(&ref)));
  };

  for (const AnyAsyncValueRef &res : operands)
    appendInput(res);
  for (const AnyAsyncValueRef &res : results)
    appendInput(res);

  for (MEFDynamicAttr attr : constantResources) {
    kernelInputs.push_back(
        const_cast<void *>(reinterpret_cast<const void *>(attr.get())));

    size_t byteCount = 1;
    if (attr.getAttrKind() == MEF::AttributeKind::kString) {
      byteCount = M::decodeMEFArrayLength(attr.get());
    } else if (((uint8_t)attr.getAttrKind()) &
               ((uint8_t)MEF::AttributeKind::mArrayType)) {
      byteCount = M::decodeMEFArrayLength(attr.get()) *
                  M::MEF::getWidthInBits(attr.getAttrKind()) / 8;
    } else {
      ASSERT_STREAM(attr.getAttrKind() != MEF::AttributeKind::kBool &&
                        attr.getAttrKind() != MEF::AttributeKind::kDictionary &&
                        attr.getAttrKind() != MEF::AttributeKind::kList &&
                        attr.getAttrKind() != MEF::AttributeKind::kType &&
                        attr.getAttrKind() != MEF::AttributeKind::kSymbolRef,
                    "unhandled type of resources.");
    }
    kernelInputs.push_back(reinterpret_cast<void *>(byteCount));
  }

  return kernelInputs;
}

/// Returns the accelerator device all operand device contexts share, and one
/// such context for pinning; otherwise kNoDevicePreference and null.
static std::pair<int, M::Driver::DeviceContextRef>
deviceHintAndContextFor(const RemainingArguments &operands) {
  TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NC("deviceHintAndContextFor", TRACY_COLOR_TEAL);

  llvm::SmallVector<M::Driver::DeviceContextRef, 8> acceleratorContexts;

  for (const AnyAsyncValueRef &operand : operands) {
    if (operand.isType<M::Driver::DeviceContextRef>()) {
      const auto &deviceCtxRef =
          *static_cast<const M::Driver::DeviceContextRef *>(
              operand.getPointerToData());
      if (deviceCtxRef->device().api() != M::Driver::Device::cpuAPI) {
        acceleratorContexts.push_back(
            M::Driver::DeviceContextRef::copy(deviceCtxRef.getPointer()));
      }
    }
  }

  // Several contexts on one device occur in side-stream regions (the
  // side-stream view plus its base context); the task still belongs on that
  // device's worker.
  if (!acceleratorContexts.empty()) {
    int deviceId = acceleratorContexts.front()->device().id();
    if (llvm::all_of(acceleratorContexts, [&](const auto &ctx) {
          return ctx->device().id() == deviceId;
        }))
      return {deviceId, std::move(acceleratorContexts.front())};
  }
  return {kNoDevicePreference, M::Driver::DeviceContextRef{}};
}

static void
mgp_generic_execute(StateContext &ctx, RemainingArguments operands,
                    RemainingResults outResults, MEFAttr<uint64_t> aSlot,
                    MEFAttr<uint64_t> bModuleIndex,
                    MEFAttr<uint64_t> cFunctionIndex,
                    MEFAttr<StringRef> dSummary, MEFAttr<bool> eIsAsync,
                    MEFListAttr fConstantResources, CPUDevice &cpuDevice) {
  TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NCT("mgp_generic_execute", TRACY_COLOR_TEAL,
                        "(Summary: " + dSummary.get().str() + ")");

  M::MGP::KernelExecutionState &kernelExecutionState =
      ctx.getStateSlotPayload<M::MGP::KernelExecutionState>(
          static_cast<size_t>(*aSlot));
  CompiledKernelAsyncABIFn *kernelPtr = kernelExecutionState.getKernelAsyncABI(
      static_cast<size_t>(*bModuleIndex), static_cast<size_t>(*cFunctionIndex));

  // deviceCtx is non-null only when deviceHint != kNoDevicePreference.
  auto [deviceHint, deviceCtx] = deviceHintAndContextFor(operands);

  AsyncRT::WorkQueue *workQueue = cpuDevice.getWorkQueue();
  int taskId =
      (deviceHint == kNoDevicePreference)
          ? kDefaultTaskId
          : MLRT::taskIdForDevice(deviceHint, workQueue->getParallelismLevel());

  // Async kernels always run out of line. Sync kernels run inline unless they
  // have task affinity and this is the wrong worker.
  if (eIsAsync.get() || !workQueue->shouldRunInlineForTask(taskId)) {
    TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NCT("-> mgp_generic_execute (async)", TRACY_COLOR_TEAL,
                          "(Summary: " + dSummary.get().str() + ")");

    // GraphRT expects allocated results; only needed here because the task
    // outlives this function.
    outResults.allocateIndirectResults();

    // Captures keep the inputs, outputs, and pinned device context alive until
    // the kernel completes.
    auto runKernelAndExtendLifetimes =
        [outResults = outResults.copyAsVector(),
         takenOperands = operands.takeAsVector(),
         constantResources = std::move(fConstantResources), kernelPtr, dSummary,
         deviceCtx = std::move(deviceCtx)]() mutable {
          TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NCT("runKernelAndExtendLifetimes", TRACY_COLOR_TEAL,
                                "(Summary: " + dSummary.get().str() + ")");

          // Results are published into `outResults` as the task's last action
          // so no downstream work starts before `kernelPtr` fully completes.
          llvm::SmallVector<AnyAsyncValueRef> localResults(outResults.size());

          llvm::SmallVector<void *> kernelInputs =
              getKernelInputs(takenOperands, localResults, constantResources);
          MAYBE_LOG_ASYNC_KERNEL(*dSummary, takenOperands, localResults);

          if (deviceCtx.getPointer() != nullptr)
            (void)deviceCtx->bindToCurrentThread();

          {
            TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NCT("Invoke Mojo function", TRACY_COLOR_ORANGE,
                                  "(Summary: " + dSummary.get().str() + ")");
            kernelPtr(reinterpret_cast<void **>(kernelInputs.data()));
          }

          if (deviceCtx.getPointer() != nullptr)
            M::Driver::DeviceContext::unbindFromCurrentThread();

          // Must have all been released/reset by the compiled kernel.
          assert(llvm::all_of(takenOperands, [](const AnyAsyncValueRef &ref) {
            return !ref.getPointer();
          }));

          // Release everything context-reachable BEFORE the driver can observe
          // completion: operand slots (already reset by the kernel) and the
          // pinned device context reference.
          takenOperands.clear();
          deviceCtx = M::Driver::DeviceContextRef();

          for (const auto &[local, output] :
               llvm::zip_equal(localResults, outResults)) {
            assert(local && "compiled kernel did not fulfill a result slot");
            std::move(output).resolveIndirect(std::move(local));
          }
        };

    AsyncRT::WorkItem workItem(std::move(runKernelAndExtendLifetimes));
    workQueue->addTask(std::move(workItem), taskId);
  } else {
    TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NCT("-> mgp_generic_execute (sync kernel)",
                          TRACY_COLOR_TEAL,
                          "(Summary: " + dSummary.get().str() + ")");

    if (deviceCtx.getPointer() != nullptr)
      (void)deviceCtx->bindToCurrentThread();

    llvm::SmallVector<void *> kernelInputs =
        getKernelInputs(operands, outResults, fConstantResources);
    MAYBE_LOG_SYNC_KERNEL(*dSummary, operands, outResults.get());
    {
      TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NCT("Invoke Mojo function", TRACY_COLOR_ORANGE,
                            "(Summary: " + dSummary.get().str() + ")");

      kernelPtr(reinterpret_cast<void **>(kernelInputs.data()));
    }

    if (deviceCtx.getPointer() != nullptr)
      M::Driver::DeviceContext::unbindFromCurrentThread();

    // Must have all been released/reset by the compiled kernel.
    assert(llvm::all_of(operands, [](const AnyAsyncValueRef &ref) {
      return !ref.getPointer();
    }));
  }
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// mgp.device_graph.execute
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

/// Returns the data pointer and byte size of a graph input operand, or nullopt
/// for context operands.
///
/// Must stay in step with `DeviceGraphCollectiveCreateOp::emitMojo`, which
/// picks the operands that get an `add_input` stable location, or inputs pair
/// with the wrong stable buffers.
static std::optional<std::pair<void *, size_t>>
graphInputData(const AnyAsyncValueRef &operand) {
  if (auto *tensor = dyn_cast<MLRT::Tensor>(operand))
    return std::pair{tensor->getMutableBuffer(), tensor->getSizeInBytes()};
  if (auto *buffer = dyn_cast<TensorBufferRef>(operand))
    return std::pair{buffer->getBuffer(), buffer->getSize()};
  return std::nullopt;
}

/// Copies the live `inputs` into `graph`'s stable input buffers. `inputs` must
/// be exactly this graph's slice of the operands.
static M::ErrorOrSuccess
copyDeviceGraphInputs(M::Driver::DeviceGraph &graph,
                      ArrayRef<AnyAsyncValueRef> inputs) {
  ArrayRef<M::Driver::DeviceBufferRef> stableInputs = graph.getInputs();
  if (stableInputs.empty())
    return M::success();

  size_t inputIdx = 0;
  for (const AnyAsyncValueRef &operand : inputs) {
    std::optional<std::pair<void *, size_t>> data = graphInputData(operand);
    if (!data)
      continue;

    if (inputIdx >= stableInputs.size())
      return Error("device graph input count mismatch");

    if (!stableInputs[inputIdx]) {
      ++inputIdx;
      continue;
    }

    M::Driver::DeviceBuffer &dst = *stableInputs[inputIdx++];
    auto [srcPtr, srcSize] = *data;

    M::Driver::DeviceContextRef ctx =
        M::Driver::DeviceContextRef::copy(&dst.context());
    M::Driver::DeviceBufferRef srcView =
        dst.isHost() ? ctx->createHostBufferOwning(srcPtr, srcSize,
                                                   /*owning=*/false)
                     : ctx->createBufferOwning(srcPtr, srcSize,
                                               /*owning=*/false);

    if (ErrorOrSuccess err = srcView->copyTo(dst))
      return err.takeError();
  }

  if (inputIdx != stableInputs.size())
    return Error("device graph input count mismatch");
  return M::success();
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// mgp.device_graph.collective.execute
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

/// Writes every stable address slot the `graphs` publish into, and waits for
/// the writes to land. A slot published by one device's graph is read by
/// another device's graph as soon as that graph launches, and nothing orders
/// the two streams, so every slot write must complete before any graph in the
/// collective starts.
static M::ErrorOrSuccess
patchCollectiveStableAddresses(ArrayRef<M::Driver::DeviceGraph *> graphs) {
  llvm::SmallVector<M::Driver::DeviceContext *, 8> patchedContexts;
  patchedContexts.reserve(graphs.size());

  for (M::Driver::DeviceGraph *graph : graphs) {
    if (graph->getStableAssignments().empty())
      continue;
    if (M::ErrorOrSuccess err = graph->patchStableAddresses())
      return err;
    patchedContexts.push_back(&graph->context());
  }

  for (M::Driver::DeviceContext *ctx : patchedContexts)
    if (M::ErrorOrSuccess err = ctx->synchronize())
      return err;
  return M::success();
}

// Replays the graphs built by `mgp.device_graph.collective.create`. Operands
// are the per-device `DeviceGraphRef`s, then every graph's live inputs in graph
// order; each graph's recorded signature sets how many it consumes.
static void mgp_device_graph_collective_execute(RemainingArguments operands,
                                                Result<Chain> outChain,
                                                RemainingResults outputs,
                                                EncodedLocation loc) {
  TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NC("mgp_device_graph_collective_execute", TRACY_COLOR_TEAL);

  SmallVector<M::Driver::DeviceGraph *, 8> graphs;

  for (const AnyAsyncValueRef &operand : operands) {
    RCRef<M::Driver::DeviceGraph> *graph =
        dyn_cast<M::Driver::DeviceGraphRef>(operand);
    if (!graph)
      break;

    graphs.push_back(graph->getPointer());
  }

  MutableArrayRef<AnyAsyncValueRef> remainingInputs =
      operands.get().slice(graphs.size());

  outputs.allocateIndirectResults();

  auto fail = [&](Error msg) {
    std::move(outChain).setToError(msg.copy());
    std::move(outputs).setAllToError(std::move(msg), loc);
  };

  // Slots first, so the writes have landed before any graph launches.
  if (M::ErrorOrSuccess err = patchCollectiveStableAddresses(graphs))
    return fail(err.takeError());

  size_t inputOffset = 0;
  size_t outputIdx = 0;

  for (M::Driver::DeviceGraph *graph : graphs) {
    // The operand list carries every value the graph's region captured, so
    // non-input values (`!mgp.context`, scalars) ride along between the data
    // operands. The graph's stable-slot count only counts data operands, so
    // grow this graph's window until it holds that many, carrying the riders
    // for `copyDeviceGraphInputs` to skip.
    size_t numStableInputs = graph->getInputs().size();
    size_t numDataInputs = 0;
    size_t windowEnd = inputOffset;
    while (numDataInputs < numStableInputs) {
      if (windowEnd == remainingInputs.size())
        return fail("device graph collective execute: input operand count "
                    "does not match graph signatures");
      if (graphInputData(remainingInputs[windowEnd]))
        ++numDataInputs;
      ++windowEnd;
    }

    ArrayRef<AnyAsyncValueRef> graphInputs =
        remainingInputs.slice(inputOffset, windowEnd - inputOffset);

    if (M::ErrorOrSuccess err = copyDeviceGraphInputs(*graph, graphInputs))
      return fail(err.takeError());

    inputOffset = windowEnd;

    if (ErrorOrSuccess err = graph->replay())
      return fail(err.takeError());

    ArrayRef<AnyAsyncValueRef> graphOutputs = graph->getOutputs();
    if (outputIdx + graphOutputs.size() > outputs.size())
      return fail("device graph collective execute: output count does not "
                  "match graph signatures");

    for (const AnyAsyncValueRef &graphOutput : graphOutputs) {
      AnyAsyncValueRef &out = outputs[outputIdx++];
      out.copy().resolveIndirect(graphOutput.copy());
    }
  }

  if (outputIdx != outputs.size())
    return fail("device graph collective execute: output count does not "
                "match graph signatures");

  std::move(outChain).emplace();
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// mgp.list.append
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

static void mgp_list_append(List &inputList, AnyAsyncValueRef element,
                            Result<List> output) {
  TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NC("mgp_list_append", TRACY_COLOR_TEAL);

  if (element.isType<Tensor>()) {
    if (!inputList.getElements().empty() &&
        inputList.getElements().front().getValue().getPointer()->getTypeID() !=
            element.getPointer()->getTypeID()) {
      std::move(output).setToError("Tensor must be from the same device");
      return;
    }
  }

  List newList = inputList.copy();
  newList.getElements().push_back(element.copy());
  std::move(output).emplace(std::move(newList));
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// mgp.list.concat
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

static void mgp_list_concat(List &lhs, List &rhs, Result<List> output) {
  TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NC("mgp_list_concat", TRACY_COLOR_TEAL);

  List resultList = lhs.copy();
  resultList.getElements().insert(resultList.getElements().end(),
                                  rhs.getElements().begin(),
                                  rhs.getElements().end());

  std::move(output).emplace(std::move(resultList));
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// mgp.list.create
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

static void mgp_list_create(RemainingArguments operands,
                            Result<List> outputList) {
  TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NC("mgp_list_create", TRACY_COLOR_TEAL);

  std::move(outputList).emplace(List{operands.copyAsVector()});
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// mgp.list.get
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

static void mgp_list_get(List &inputList, Tensor &idxTensor,
                         RemainingResults outputs, EncodedLocation loc) {
  TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NC("mgp_list_get", TRACY_COLOR_TEAL);

  // We must unbox the index value from the tensor.
  // TODO: Should be ssize_t.
  idxTensor.getEltType()
      .dispatch<void>(idxTensor.getBuffer())
      .template when<DType::si32, DType::si64>([&](auto *idxDataPtr) {
        auto idx = *idxDataPtr;

        int64_t listSize = inputList.getElements().size();
        if (idx < -listSize || listSize <= idx) {
          return std::move(outputs).setAllToError(
              Twine("index ") + Twine(idx) +
                  " is out of bound for list of size " + Twine(listSize),
              loc);
        }

        if (idx < 0)
          idx += listSize;

        // Elements have arbitrary types, so no typed `Result<...>`; sharing
        // the `AsyncValueRef` also avoids deep-copying values like `Tensor`.
        *outputs.begin() = inputList.getElements()[idx].getValue().copy();
      });
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// mgp.list.insert
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

static void mgp_list_insert(List &inputList, AnyAsyncValueRef element,
                            Tensor &idxTensor, Result<List> output) {
  TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NC("mgp_list_insert", TRACY_COLOR_TEAL);

  // We must unbox the index value from the tensor.
  // TODO: Should be ssize_t.
  idxTensor.getEltType()
      .dispatch<void>(idxTensor.getBuffer())
      .template when<DType::si32, DType::si64>([&](auto *idxDataPtr) {
        auto idx = *idxDataPtr;

        int64_t listSize = inputList.getElements().size();
        if (idx < -listSize || listSize < idx) {
          return std::move(output).setToError(
              Twine("index ") + Twine(idx) +
              " is out of bound for list of size " + Twine(listSize));
        }

        if (idx < 0)
          idx += listSize;

        List newList = inputList.copy();
        newList.getElements().insert(newList.getElements().begin() + idx,
                                     element.copy());
        std::move(output).emplace(std::move(newList));
      });
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// mgp.list.slice
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

static void mgp_list_slice(List &inputList, Tensor &startTensor,
                           Tensor &endTensor, Tensor &stepTensor,
                           Result<List> output) {
  TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NC("mgp_list_slice", TRACY_COLOR_TEAL);

  auto sliceFunctor = [&](auto start, auto end, auto step) {
    List resultList;

    auto &elems = inputList.getElements();

    ssize_t length = elems.size();

    if (step == 0) {
      return std::move(output).setToError(
          "The slice step argument must be a non-zero");
    }

    const bool stepIsPositive = step > 0;

    if (start < 0) {
      start += length;
    }
    if (end < 0) {
      end += length;
    }

    if (stepIsPositive) {
      start = std::clamp<decltype(start)>(start, 0, length - 1);
      end = std::clamp<decltype(end)>(end, 0, length);
    } else {
      start = std::clamp<decltype(start)>(start, 0, length - 1);
      end = std::clamp<decltype(end)>(end, -1, length);
    }

    if (stepIsPositive) {
      for (ssize_t i = start; i < end && i < length && i >= 0; i += step) {
        resultList.getElements().push_back(inputList.getElements()[i]);
      }
    } else {
      for (ssize_t i = start; i > end; i += step) {
        resultList.getElements().push_back(inputList.getElements()[i]);
      }
    }

    std::move(output).emplace(std::move(resultList));
  };

  startTensor.getEltType()
      .dispatch<void>(startTensor.getBuffer())
      .template when<DType::si32, DType::si64>([&](auto *startDataPtr) {
        auto start = *startDataPtr;

        endTensor.getEltType()
            .dispatch<void>(endTensor.getBuffer())
            .template when<DType::si32, DType::si64>([&](auto *endDataPtr) {
              auto end = *endDataPtr;

              stepTensor.getEltType()
                  .dispatch<void>(stepTensor.getBuffer())
                  .template when<DType::si32, DType::si64>(
                      [&](auto *stepDataPtr) {
                        auto step = *stepDataPtr;
                        sliceFunctor(start, end, step);
                      });
            });
      });
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// mgp.guard
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

static void mgp_guard(Chain inChain, RemainingArguments inputs,
                      RemainingResults results) {
  TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NC("mgp_guard", TRACY_COLOR_TEAL);

  assert(inputs.size() == results.size());

  auto inputAsyncVals = inputs.get();
  auto resultAsyncVals = results.get();

  for (const auto &[input, result] :
       llvm::zip(inputAsyncVals, resultAsyncVals)) {
    result = std::move(input);
  }
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// mgp.model
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

static void mgp_model() {
  TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NC("mgp_model", TRACY_COLOR_TEAL);

  ASSERT_STREAM(false, << "mgp.model should never be invoked");
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// mgp.extend.lifetime
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

// Runs once all operands are ready, keeping them alive until then.
static void mgp_nop(RemainingArguments operands, Result<Chain> outChain) {
  TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NC("mgp_nop", TRACY_COLOR_TEAL);

  std::move(outChain).emplace();
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// mgp.runtime.create
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

void mgp_runtime_create(Chain inChain, StateContext &theContext,
                        Result<Chain> outChain, MEFAttr<uint64_t> aRuntimeSlot,
                        CPUDevice &cpuDevice) {
  TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NC("mgp_runtime_create", TRACY_COLOR_TEAL);

  // M::Context is not in the primitive invocation ABI; callers (engine, mt,
  // mo-opt) create it and it is retrieved here.
  M::ContextRef ctxRef = Init::getContext();

  // One execution engine is shared by all models using this cpuDevice.
  //
  // TODO(#30647): Currently there's no garbage collection of dylibs loaded into
  //               this engine.
  ErrorOr<KGEN::ExecutionEngine *> engineOr =
      ctxRef->createIfMissing<KGEN::ExecutionEngine>(
          [&]() -> ErrorOr<std::unique_ptr<KGEN::ExecutionEngine>> {
            llvm::InitializeNativeTarget();
            llvm::InitializeNativeTargetAsmParser();
            llvm::InitializeNativeTargetAsmPrinter();
            auto targetMachineOr = getTargetMachineForHost();
            if (targetMachineOr.isError())
              return targetMachineOr.takeError();

            auto cfgOr = KGEN::MojoConfig::open();
            if (cfgOr.isError())
              return cfgOr.takeError();
            KGEN::MojoConfig cfg = std::move(*cfgOr);

            KGEN::ExecutionEngineOptions options;
            options.registerPerfPlugins =
                cpuDevice.getProfilerDebuginfo() ==
                M::AsyncRT::CPUDeviceOptions::ProfilerDebuginfo::kPerfProfiler;
            options.libraryPaths.push_back(cfg.getMGPRTPath());
            return KGEN::ExecutionEngine::createWithStandardLayers(
                std::move(options), **targetMachineOr);
          });

  if (engineOr.isError())
    return std::move(outChain).setToError(engineOr.takeError());

  theContext.emplaceStateSlot<KernelExecutionState>(
      static_cast<size_t>(*aRuntimeSlot), *engineOr);

  std::move(outChain).emplace();
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// mgp.device_context.select_stream
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

static ErrorOr<M::Driver::DeviceContextRef>
mgp_device_context_select_stream(M::Driver::DeviceContextRef &deviceContext,
                                 MEFAttr<uint64_t> streamId) {
  TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NC("mgp_device_context_select_stream", TRACY_COLOR_TEAL);
  return deviceContext->selectStream(static_cast<unsigned>(*streamId));
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// mgp.buffer.cache
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

static void mgp_buffer_cache(Chain inChain, StateContext &theContext,
                             AsyncValueRef<TensorBufferRef> buffer,
                             Result<Chain> outChain,
                             MEFAttr<uint64_t> bBufferSlot,
                             CPUDevice &cpuDevice) {
  TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NC("mgp_buffer_cache", TRACY_COLOR_TEAL);

  auto &tensorStateSlot = theContext.emplaceStateSlot<TensorStateSlot>(
      static_cast<size_t>(*bBufferSlot));

  // Always borrow the buffer.
  ErrorOrSuccess errOr = tensorStateSlot.setBuffer(buffer.get().borrow());

  if (errOr.isError())
    return std::move(outChain).setToError(errOr.takeError());
  std::move(outChain).emplace();
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// registerMGPPrimitives
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

void M::registerMGPPrimitives(PrimitiveRegistry &registry) {
  ADD_PRIMITIVE(registry, "mgp.runtime.create", mgp_runtime_create);
  ADD_PRIMITIVE(registry, "mgp.device_context.select_stream",
                mgp_device_context_select_stream);
  ADD_PRIMITIVE(registry, "mgp.buffer.cache", mgp_buffer_cache);
  ADD_PRIMITIVE(registry, "mgp.context.create", mgp_context_create);
  ADD_PRIMITIVE(registry, "mgp.generic.execute", mgp_generic_execute);
  ADD_PRIMITIVE(registry, "mgp.device_graph.collective.execute",
                mgp_device_graph_collective_execute);
  ADD_PRIMITIVE(registry, "mgp.list.append", mgp_list_append);
  ADD_PRIMITIVE(registry, "mgp.guard", mgp_guard);
  ADD_PRIMITIVE(registry, "mgp.list.concat", mgp_list_concat);
  ADD_PRIMITIVE(registry, "mgp.list.create", mgp_list_create);
  ADD_PRIMITIVE(registry, "mgp.list.get", mgp_list_get);
  ADD_PRIMITIVE(registry, "mgp.list.insert", mgp_list_insert);
  ADD_PRIMITIVE(registry, "mgp.list.slice", mgp_list_slice);
  ADD_PRIMITIVE(registry, "mgp.model", mgp_model);

  ADD_PRIMITIVE(registry, "mgp.extend.lifetime", mgp_nop);

  registerMGPCPUPrimitives(registry);
}

"""
The code below computes the attention score for a tile of size BN x BD.
It follows the exact arithmetic as described in the FlashAttention-2 paper
(https://arxiv.org/pdf/2307.08691). The variable names in this program
reflect the variable names in the algorithms from the paper.

Here, the following tensors are Q for the query,
K for the key, V for the value, and O for the output.

       Q            K               V
  +----D----+  +----D----+   +--+--BD--+---+
  |         |  |.........|   |  |......|   |
  |         |  |.........|   |  |......|   |
  +---------+  |.........|   |  |......|   |
  |.........|  |.........|   |  |......|   |
  BN........|  N.........|   N  |......|   |
  |.........|  |.........|   |  |......|   |
  +---------+  |.........|   |  |......|   |
  |         |  |.........|   |  |......|   |
  |         |  |.........|   |  |......|   |
  |         |  |.........|   |  |......|   |
  +---------+  +---------+   +--+------+---+

The main trick is in the softmax computation.
As the paper says, S and P are intermediate values.

Let S = Q * K^T  ∈ R^{N, D}
    P = Softmax(S) ∈ R^{N, D}
The attention score is O = P * V ∈ R^{N, D}.

One way to think about this is to consider what happens if we
split the dimensions N in  K, and Q into two tiles: K_1 and K_2, V_1 and V_2.
Then we can incrementally compute the output as follows:
  S_1 = Q * K_1, S_2 = Q * K_2
  O_i = O_{i-1} * renormalization_factor + softmax(S_i) * V_i

This allows for the incremental computation of softmax(S_i) * V_i,
leading to the final output.
"""


from max.gpu.host import DeviceContext
from max.gpu import block_idx
from max.gpu.sync import barrier
from layout import TensorLayout, TileTensor, row_major, stack_allocation
from layout.math import max, sum
from layout.tensor_core import TensorCore

from extensibility import register, InputTensor, OutputTensor

from std.utils import Index


@register("modular_ops::fused_attention_custom")
struct FusedAttention:
    """Registers the `fused_attention_custom` op, allowing python to use it from the `max`
    package.
    """

    @staticmethod
    def execute[
        dtype: DType,
        rank: Int,
        //,  # Forces the previous two params to be inferred from the args
        BN: Int,  # Dimension of blocks to split Q into
        BD: Int,  # Dimension of blocks to split K, V into
        target: StaticString,  # "cpu" or "gpu"
    ](
        output: OutputTensor[dtype=dtype, rank=rank, ...],
        query: InputTensor[dtype=dtype, rank=rank, ...],
        key: InputTensor[dtype=dtype, rank=rank, ...],
        value: InputTensor[dtype=dtype, rank=rank, ...],
        ctx: DeviceContext,
    ) raises:
        comptime assert rank == 2, "rank must be 2"

        # Query tensor
        var Q = query.to_tile_tensor().as_unsafe_any_origin()
        # Key tensor
        var K = key.to_tile_tensor().as_unsafe_any_origin()
        # Value tensor
        var V = value.to_tile_tensor().as_unsafe_any_origin()
        # Attention output tensor
        var O = output.to_tile_tensor().as_unsafe_any_origin()

        comptime if target == "cpu":
            print("Running on CPU")
            fused_attention_cpu[BN, BD](Q, K, V, O)
        else:
            var dev_ctx = ctx
            print("Running on GPU")
            fused_attention_gpu[BN, BD](dev_ctx, Q, K, V, O)


# CustomOpLibrary does not support names with '::' in them currently. Create
# a simple alias so the whisper example works.
@register("fused_attention_custom")
struct FusedAttentionAlias:
    @staticmethod
    def execute[
        dtype: DType,
        rank: Int,
        //,  # Forces the previous two params to be inferred from the args
        BN: Int,  # Dimension of blocks to split Q into
        BD: Int,  # Dimension of blocks to split K, V into
        target: StaticString,  # "cpu" or "gpu"
    ](
        output: OutputTensor[dtype=dtype, rank=rank, ...],
        query: InputTensor[dtype=dtype, rank=rank, ...],
        key: InputTensor[dtype=dtype, rank=rank, ...],
        value: InputTensor[dtype=dtype, rank=rank, ...],
        ctx: DeviceContext,
    ) raises:
        FusedAttention.execute[BN=BN, BD=BD, target=target](
            output, query, key, value, ctx
        )


@inline(.always)
def matmul_b_transpose(
    lhs: TileTensor,
    rhs: TileTensor,
    out res: TileTensor[
        lhs.dtype,
        type_of(row_major[lhs.static_shape[0], rhs.static_shape[0]]()),
        MutUntrackedOrigin,
    ],
):
    res = stack_allocation[lhs.dtype](
        row_major[lhs.static_shape[0], rhs.static_shape[0]]()
    )

    comptime for m in range(lhs.static_shape[0]):
        comptime for n in range(rhs.static_shape[0]):
            res[m, n] = 0.0

            comptime for k in range(lhs.static_shape[1]):
                res[m, n] += rebind[res.ElementType](
                    lhs[m, k].cast[res.dtype]()
                ) * rebind[res.ElementType](rhs[n, k].cast[res.dtype]())


# The bulk of the code below implements what the papers calls
# an "online softmax", which is local to each block.
# The algorithm is described as:
#
# $$$
# m_1 = rowmax(S_1)
# l_1 = rowsum(e^(S_1-m_1))
# P_1 = diag(l_1)^-1 * e^(S_1-m_1)
# O_1 = P_1*V_1 = diag(l_1)^-1 * e^(S_1-m_1) * V_1
# m_2 = max(m_1, rowmax(S_2)) = m
# l_2 = e^(m_1-m_2) * l_1 _ rowsum(e^(S_2-m_2))
#     = rowsum(e^(S_1-m)) + rowsum(e^(S_2-m)) = ls
# P_2 = diag(l_2)^-1 * e^(S_2-m_2)
# O_2 = diag(l_1/l_2)^-1 * O_1 + (P_2 * V_2)
#     = diag(l_2)^-1 * e^(S_2-m) * V
# $$$


@inline(.always)
def fused_attention_cpu[
    BN: Int, BD: Int
](Q: TileTensor, K: TileTensor, V: TileTensor, O: TileTensor[mut=True, ...],):
    comptime N = K.static_shape[0]
    comptime D = K.static_shape[1]

    comptime for tile_n in range(N // BN):
        var Q_tile = Q.tile[BN, D](tile_n, 0)

        comptime for tile_d in range(D // BD):
            var m_1 = stack_allocation[Q.dtype](row_major[BN]()).fill(
                Scalar[Q.dtype].MIN
            )

            var l_1 = stack_allocation[Q.dtype](row_major[BN]()).fill(0)

            var O_i = stack_allocation[Q.dtype](row_major[BN, BD]()).fill(0)

            comptime for tile_n_idx in range(N // BN):
                var K_tile = K.tile[BN, D](tile_n_idx, 0)
                var V_tile = V.tile[BN, BD](tile_n_idx, tile_d)

                var S = matmul_b_transpose(Q_tile, K_tile)
                var m_2 = stack_allocation[Q.dtype](row_major[BN]())
                max[axis=1](S, m_2)
                m_2.max(m_1)

                # l_2 = exp(m_1 - m_2) * l_1 + sum(axis=1, exp(S - m_2))
                var l_2 = stack_allocation[Q.dtype](row_major[BN]())
                l_2.copy_from(m_1)
                l_2 -= m_2
                l_2.exp()
                l_2 *= l_1
                var E = stack_allocation[Q.dtype](row_major[BN, BN]())
                E.copy_from(S)
                E -= m_2
                E.exp()
                var l_2_sum = stack_allocation[Q.dtype](row_major[BN]())
                sum[axis=1](E, l_2_sum)
                l_2 += l_2_sum

                # P = exp(S - m_2) / l_2
                E /= l_2
                O_i *= l_1
                O_i /= l_2
                var m_1_delta = stack_allocation[Q.dtype](row_major[BN]())
                m_1_delta.copy_from(m_1)
                m_1_delta -= m_2
                m_1_delta.exp()
                O_i *= m_1_delta
                var PV = matmul["cpu"](E, V_tile)
                O_i += PV
                m_1.copy_from(m_2)
                l_1.copy_from(l_2)

            O.tile[BN, BD](tile_n, tile_d).copy_from(O_i)


@inline(.always)
def matmul[
    dtype: DType,
    rhs_dtype: DType,
    //,
    target: StaticString,
    transpose_b: Bool = False,
](
    lhs: TileTensor[dtype, ...],
    rhs: TileTensor[rhs_dtype, ...],
    out res: TileTensor[
        dtype,
        type_of(row_major[lhs.static_shape[0], rhs.static_shape[0]]()),
        MutUntrackedOrigin,
        address_space=lhs.address_space,
    ],
):
    res = stack_allocation[dtype, address_space=lhs.address_space](
        row_major[lhs.static_shape[0], rhs.static_shape[0]]()
    )

    comptime if target == "cpu":
        comptime for m in range(lhs.static_shape[0]):
            comptime for n in range(rhs.static_shape[1]):
                res[m, n] = 0.0

                comptime for k in range(lhs.static_shape[1]):
                    res[m, n] += rebind[res.ElementType](
                        lhs[m, k].cast[res.dtype]()
                    ) * rebind[res.ElementType](rhs[k, n].cast[res.dtype]())
    else:
        comptime M = lhs.static_shape[0]
        comptime N = rhs.static_shape[0]
        comptime K = lhs.static_shape[1]

        var out_sram = stack_allocation[res.dtype, address_space=.SHARED](
            row_major[M, N]()
        )

        comptime BK = 8

        comptime assert K % 8 == 0, "K needs to be a multiple of 8"

        var mma_b_t = TensorCore[dtype, dtype, Index(M, N, BK), transpose_b]()

        var c_reg = stack_allocation[dtype, address_space=.LOCAL](
            mma_b_t.c_fragment_layout
        ).fill(0)

        # `TensorCore`'s native loads require matching operand dtypes;
        # rebind the B view once when `rhs` carries a different dtype.
        var rhs_typed = rebind[
            TileTensor[
                dtype,
                rhs.LayoutType,
                rhs.origin,
                Engine=rhs.Engine,
                address_space=rhs.address_space,
                linear_idx_type=rhs.linear_idx_type,
            ]
        ](rhs)

        comptime for k_i in range(K // BK):
            var a_reg = mma_b_t.load_a(lhs.tile[M, BK](0, k_i))

            var b_reg = mma_b_t.load_b(rhs_typed.tile[BK, N](k_i, 0))

            comptime if transpose_b:
                b_reg = rebind[type_of(b_reg)](
                    mma_b_t.load_b(rhs_typed.tile[N, BK](0, k_i))
                )

            var d_reg = mma_b_t.mma_op(a_reg, b_reg, c_reg)
            c_reg.copy_from(d_reg)
        mma_b_t.store_d(out_sram, c_reg)

        barrier()
        res.copy_from(out_sram)


def fused_attention_kernel[
    q_dtype: DType,
    q_layout: TensorLayout,
    k_dtype: DType,
    k_layout: TensorLayout,
    v_dtype: DType,
    v_layout: TensorLayout,
    o_dtype: DType,
    o_layout: TensorLayout,
    BN: Int,
    BD: Int,
](
    Q: TileTensor[q_dtype, q_layout, MutAnyOrigin],
    K: TileTensor[k_dtype, k_layout, MutAnyOrigin],
    V: TileTensor[v_dtype, v_layout, MutAnyOrigin],
    O: TileTensor[o_dtype, o_layout, MutAnyOrigin],
):
    comptime N = Q.static_shape[0]
    comptime D = Q.static_shape[1]

    var Q_tile = Q.tile[BN, D](block_idx.y, 0)

    var m_1 = stack_allocation[q_dtype](row_major[BN]()).fill(
        Scalar[q_dtype].MIN
    )
    var l_1 = stack_allocation[q_dtype](row_major[BN]()).fill(0)
    var O_i = stack_allocation[q_dtype](row_major[BN, BD]()).fill(0)

    comptime BN_1 = 8

    for tile_n_idx in range(N // BN_1):
        var K_tile = K.tile[BN_1, D](tile_n_idx, 0)
        var V_tile = V.tile[BN_1, BD](tile_n_idx, block_idx.x)
        var S = matmul["gpu", transpose_b=True](Q_tile, K_tile)
        var m_2 = stack_allocation[q_dtype](row_major[BN]())
        max[axis=1](S, m_2)
        m_2.max(m_1)

        # l_2 = exp(m_1 - m_2) * l_1 + sum(axis=1, exp(S - m_2))
        var l_2 = stack_allocation[q_dtype](row_major[BN]())
        l_2.copy_from(m_1)
        l_2 -= m_2
        l_2.exp()
        l_2 *= l_1
        var E = stack_allocation[q_dtype](row_major[BN, BN_1]())
        E.copy_from(S)
        E -= m_2
        E.exp()
        var l_2_sum = stack_allocation[q_dtype](row_major[BN]())
        sum[axis=1](E, l_2_sum)
        l_2 += l_2_sum

        # P = exp(S - m_2) / l_2
        E /= l_2
        O_i *= l_1
        O_i /= l_2
        var m_1_delta = stack_allocation[q_dtype](row_major[BN]())
        m_1_delta.copy_from(m_1)
        m_1_delta -= m_2
        m_1_delta.exp()
        O_i *= m_1_delta
        var PV = matmul["gpu"](E, V_tile)
        O_i += PV
        m_1.copy_from(m_2)
        l_1.copy_from(l_2)
    O.tile[BN, BD](block_idx.y, block_idx.x).copy_from(O_i)


def fused_attention_gpu[
    BN: Int,
    BD: Int,
](
    ctx: DeviceContext,
    Q: TileTensor,
    K: TileTensor,
    V: TileTensor,
    O: TileTensor[mut=True, ...],
) raises:
    comptime kernel_func = fused_attention_kernel[
        Q.dtype,
        Q.LayoutType,
        K.dtype,
        K.LayoutType,
        V.dtype,
        V.LayoutType,
        O.dtype,
        O.LayoutType,
        BN,
        BD,
    ]
    ctx.enqueue_function[kernel_func](
        Q,
        K,
        V,
        O,
        grid_dim=(Int(Q.dim[1]()) // BD, Int(Q.dim[0]()) // BN),
        block_dim=(32),
    )

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// RuntimeContext initialization
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

static CPUDeviceOptions
getOrCreateCPUDeviceOptions(const Engine::Config &config,
                            StringRef profileFilename) {
  AsyncRT::CPUDeviceOptions cpuDeviceOptions;
  cpuDeviceOptions.numThreads = config.getNumThreads();
  cpuDeviceOptions.maxThreads = config.getMaxThreads();
  cpuDeviceOptions.tcmallocAllocator =
      config.getAllocatorType() == (int)kCaching;
  cpuDeviceOptions.threadBusyWaitTime = config.getThreadBusyWaitTime().count();
  cpuDeviceOptions.profileFilename = profileFilename;
  cpuDeviceOptions.poolName = config.getContextName();
  if (cpuDeviceOptions.numThreads == 1)
    cpuDeviceOptions.withSingleThreaded();
  // Previously mainWillDonate was required to be false in order to avoid the
  // Runtime created by the Engine from overwriting the Runtime created by the
  // Mojo stdlib during startup, this is no longer the case. Though there is
  // still a question of whether the Engine should be initialized with
  // mainWillDonate as true or false, setting to true currently causes an issue
  // with integration with the Torch inductor. See GEX-3387 for details.
  cpuDeviceOptions.mainWillDonate = false;

  return cpuDeviceOptions;
}

static void setUnknownLocError(AnyAsyncValueRef &&asyncVal, Error error) {
  std::move(asyncVal).setToError(
      {std::move(error), UnknownLocationDecoder::getEncodedLocation()});
}

static ErrorOr<std::unique_ptr<ExecutableModel>>
createExecutableModel(const M::Model *model, CPUDevice &cpuDevice,
                      const Engine::Config &config,
                      const WeightsRegistry *weightsRegistry) {
  M::GraphCompiler::Driver::DeviceMap deviceMap;
  for (const auto &device : config.getDevices())
    deviceMap.insert({device.spec->ref, device.context});
  auto executableModelOr = model->setup(cpuDevice, weightsRegistry, deviceMap);
  if (executableModelOr.isError())
    return executableModelOr.takeError().getMessage().copy();

  auto executableModel = executableModelOr.takeValue();
  auto setupErrorOrSuccess = executableModel->waitForModelSetup();
  if (setupErrorOrSuccess.isError())
    return Error(Twine("Model setup failed, not ready for execution.  "
                       "Modular internal detail: ") +
                 setupErrorOrSuccess.getError());
  return std::move(executableModel);
}

static ErrorOr<ExecutableModels>
createExecutableModels(const CompiledModels &compiledModels,
                       CPUDevice &cpuDevice, const Engine::Config &config,
                       const WeightsRegistry *weightsRegistry) {
  if (compiledModels.getNumModels() == 0)
    return Error::getStaticString(
        "Compiled model does not contain any valid models");

  ExecutableModels results;
  results.reserve(compiledModels.getNumModels());

  for (const std::unique_ptr<const Model> &model : compiledModels) {
    ErrorOr<std::unique_ptr<ExecutableModel>> executableModelOr =
        createExecutableModel(model.get(), cpuDevice, config, weightsRegistry);
    if (executableModelOr.isError())
      return executableModelOr.takeError();
    results.push_back(executableModelOr.takeValue());
  }
  return results;
}

static ErrorOr<TensorMap>
executeExecutableModel(const ExecutableModel &executableModel,
                       TensorMap &inputMap, CPUDevice &cpuDevice) {
  auto inputNames = executableModel.getModel()->getInputNames();

  SmallVector<AnyAsyncValueRef> inputValuesInMEFIndexOrder;
  inputValuesInMEFIndexOrder.reserve(inputMap.tensors.size());

  // Iterating on names in MEF order here.
  for (auto inputName : inputNames) {
    auto it = inputMap.tensors.find(inputName);
    if (it == inputMap.tensors.end()) {
      return Error("The model requires an input tensor named '" + inputName +
                   "' but it was not provided.");
    }

    inputValuesInMEFIndexOrder.emplace_back(it->second.copy());
  }

  auto results = executableModel.execute(inputValuesInMEFIndexOrder);

  if (results.empty())
    return Error("Failed to execute model");

  if (auto err = AsyncRT::awaitOrError(results))
    return err.takeError();

  MutableArrayRef<AnyAsyncValueRef> resultCopy(results.data(), results.size());
  resultCopy = resultCopy.drop_front();
  llvm::SmallVector<AnyAsyncValueRef> outputTensorRefs;
  outputTensorRefs.reserve(resultCopy.size());
  for (auto &result : resultCopy) {
    outputTensorRefs.push_back(std::move(result));
  }

  AsyncRT::await(outputTensorRefs);

  llvm::StringMap<AnyAsyncValueRef> resultMap;
  auto outputNames = executableModel.getModel()->getOutputNames();
  for (auto [outIdx, tensor] : llvm::enumerate(outputTensorRefs)) {
    if (tensor.isError())
      return tensor.getDiagnostic().getMessage().copy();

    resultMap.insert({outputNames[outIdx], std::move(tensor)});
  }

  return TensorMap(std::move(resultMap), cpuDevice);
}

ErrorOr<Engine::Context>
Engine::Context::create(const M::Engine::Config &config) {
  std::string profileFilename =
      llvm::sys::Process::GetEnv("MODULAR_PROFILE_FILENAME").value_or("");

  ContextRef maxContext;
  if (ContextRef ctx = config.getMaxContext()) {
    maxContext = std::move(ctx);
  } else {
    Init::Options options;
    CPUDeviceOptions rtOptions =
        getOrCreateCPUDeviceOptions(config, profileFilename);
    options.withCPUDeviceOptions(rtOptions);
    options.withForceDisableCrashReporting(!config.isCrashLogEnabled());

    auto contextOr = Init::getOrCreateContext("max-engine", options);
    if (contextOr.isError())
      return contextOr.takeError();
    maxContext = contextOr.takeValue();
  }
  auto runtimeContext = Engine::Context(config, maxContext.copy());
  auto &maxTelemetryContext =
      runtimeContext.maxContext
          ->emplaceIfMissing<GML::MaxEngineTelemetryContext>(maxContext.copy());
  maxTelemetryContext.setAPILanguage(config.getAPILanguage().str());

  // Source of truth for the closed set of valid device labels. Downstream
  // consumers (notably the C-API M_HOST vs M_ACCELERATOR predicate in
  // M_getDeviceType / M_getDeviceTypeFromSpec) treat anything not rejected
  // here as a valid device, so this guard must stay in sync with the
  // kCPULabel / kGPULabel constants in Support/DeviceSpecs.h.
  for (const auto &device : config.getDevices()) {
    const DeviceSpec &spec = *device.spec;
    if (spec.ref.label != kCPULabel && spec.ref.label != kGPULabel) {
      return Error(Twine("unrecognized device '") + spec.ref.label + "'");
    }
    // else: no special extra device handling
  }
  return runtimeContext;
}

Engine::Context::Context(Context &&other)
    : maxContext(std::move(other.maxContext)), config(std::move(other.config)),
      cpuDevice(*maxContext->get<CPUDevice>()) {}

Engine::Context::Context(const M::Engine::Config &runtimeConfig,
                         M::ContextRef context)
    : maxContext(std::move(context)), config(runtimeConfig),
      cpuDevice(*maxContext->get<CPUDevice>()) {
  crashRecoveryContext.DumpStackAndCleanupOnFailure = true;
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// Model compilation, loading, and initialization
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

AsyncValueRef<CompiledModels>
Engine::Context::compileModel(CompilationRequest config) const {
  auto compiledModelAsync = AsyncValueRef<CompiledModels>::allocate(cpuDevice);

  addTask(cpuDevice, [config = std::move(config),
                      compiledModelAsync = compiledModelAsync.copy(),
                      this]() mutable {
    auto compiledModelOr = compileModelSync(std::move(config));

    auto &telemetryCtx = *maxContext->get<GML::MaxEngineTelemetryContext>();

    if (compiledModelOr.isError()) {
      Error compileError = compiledModelOr.takeError();
      // FIXME: This potentially can contain absolute file paths in user
      // machine. We might need to scrub that.
      Telemetry::emitCompileInfo("compile.failure", telemetryCtx,
                                 compileError.copy());
      return setUnknownLocError(std::move(compiledModelAsync),
                                std::move(compileError));
    }

    Telemetry::emitCompileInfo("compile.success", telemetryCtx, {});
    std::move(compiledModelAsync).emplace(compiledModelOr.takeValue());
  });

  return compiledModelAsync;
}

static void telemetryEmitModelFormat(FileFormat format, ContextRef context) {
  auto telemetryContext = context->get<Telemetry::TelemetryContext>();
  Telemetry::emitCompiledModelType(*telemetryContext, format);
}

static void telemetryEmitPipelineName(std::string_view pipelineName,
                                      ContextRef context) {
  auto telemetryContext = context->get<Telemetry::TelemetryContext>();
  Telemetry::emitPipelineName("max.pipeline.run", *telemetryContext,
                              pipelineName);
}

/// Compiles a model. Functionally identical to `M_compileModel`, but blocks
/// on execution. Unlike `M_compileModel`, the user does not need to call
/// `M_waitForCompilation` to await a compilation result. Also does not use CAS
/// for kernel caching.
ErrorOr<CompiledModels>
Engine::Context::compileModelSync(CompilationRequest config) const {
  config.setDevices(this->config.getDevices());
  auto modelOr =
      CompiledModels::create(maxContext.copy(), config, this->config);
  if (modelOr.isError())
    return modelOr.takeError();

  if (auto pipelineName = config.getPipelineName(); pipelineName)
    telemetryEmitPipelineName(*pipelineName, maxContext);
  telemetryEmitModelFormat(modelOr.get().getSourceModel().format(), maxContext);

  return modelOr.takeValue();
}

ErrorOrSuccess Engine::Context::await(AnyAsyncValueRef value) {
  return AsyncRT::awaitOrError(value);
}

M::AsyncExecutableModel
Engine::Context::initModel(const M::Model *model,
                           const WeightsRegistryRef &weightsRegistry) const {
  using ModelType = std::unique_ptr<M::ExecutableModel>;
  auto result = AsyncValueRef<ModelType>::allocate(cpuDevice);

  // Run on a cpuDevice worker thread to ensure AsyncRT cpuDevice is set in TLS.
  // (MGP_RT_BufferBorrowV2, called during Model::setup, requires a valid
  // current cpuDevice.)
  addTask(cpuDevice, [model, weights = weightsRegistry.copy(),
                      result = result.copy(), this]() mutable {
    auto executableModelOr = createExecutableModel(
        model, cpuDevice, getConfig(), weights.getPointer());
    if (executableModelOr.isError())
      return setUnknownLocError(std::move(result),
                                executableModelOr.takeError());
    std::move(result).emplace(executableModelOr.takeValue());
  });

  return result;
}

AsyncValueRef<ExecutableModels>
Engine::Context::initModel(AsyncValueRef<CompiledModels> compiledModels,
                           const WeightsRegistryRef &weightsRegistry) const {
  auto result = AsyncValueRef<ExecutableModels>::allocate(cpuDevice);

  // Use andThenAsync to ensure createExecutableModels runs on a cpuDevice
  // worker thread.  The caller may be a foreign thread (e.g. a Python
  // ThreadPoolExecutor thread) that has no AsyncRT cpuDevice set in its
  // thread-local storage; MGP_RT_BufferBorrowV2 (called during Model::setup)
  // requires a valid current cpuDevice.
  std::move(compiledModels)
      .andThenAsync(
          [result = result.copy(), weights = weightsRegistry.copy(),
           this](AsyncValueRef<CompiledModels> &&compiledModelsRef) mutable {
            if (compiledModelsRef.isError())
              return setUnknownLocError(
                  std::move(result),
                  compiledModelsRef.takeDiagnostic().getMessage().copy());

            auto executableModelsOr =
                createExecutableModels(compiledModelsRef.get(), cpuDevice,
                                       getConfig(), weights.getPointer());
            if (executableModelsOr.isError())
              return setUnknownLocError(std::move(result),
                                        executableModelsOr.takeError());

            std::move(result).emplace(executableModelsOr.takeValue());
          });

  return result;
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// Model execution
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

AsyncValueRef<TensorMap>
Engine::Context::execute(AsyncExecutableModel executableModel,
                         AsyncValueRef<TensorMap> inputTensorMap) const {
  auto outputTensorMap = AsyncValueRef<TensorMap>::allocate(cpuDevice);
  AsyncExecutableModel executableModelRef = executableModel.copy();
  executableModel.andThenAsync([this, inTensorMap = inputTensorMap.copy(),
                                outTensorMap = outputTensorMap.copy(),
                                executableModelRef =
                                    std::move(executableModelRef)]() mutable {
    if (executableModelRef.isError()) {
      return std::move(outTensorMap)
          .setToError(executableModelRef.takeDiagnostic());
    }

    AsyncRT::await(inTensorMap);
    auto &inputMap = inTensorMap.get();

    std::unique_ptr<ExecutableModel> &executableModel =
        executableModelRef.get();
    if (!executableModel) {
      return std::move(outTensorMap)
          .setToError({Error::getStaticString("Executable model not available"),
                       UnknownLocationDecoder::getEncodedLocation()});
    }

    ErrorOr<TensorMap> outputsOr =
        executeExecutableModel(*executableModel, inputMap, cpuDevice);
    if (outputsOr.isError()) {
      const Model *model = executableModel->getModel();
      return std::move(outTensorMap)
          .setToError({outputsOr.takeError(),
                       model ? model->getLocation().copy()
                             : UnknownLocationDecoder::getEncodedLocation()});
    }
    std::move(outTensorMap).emplace(outputsOr.takeValue());
  });
  return outputTensorMap;
}

ErrorOr<ArrayRef<QuantTensorSpec>>
Engine::Context::getInputSpecs(AsyncValueRef<CompiledModels> compiledModels,
                               size_t modelIndex) {
  if (auto err = AsyncRT::awaitOrError(compiledModels))
    return err.takeError();

  if (auto model = compiledModels->getModel(modelIndex))
    return model->getInputSpecs();

  return Error::getStaticString("model index out of bounds");
}

ErrorOr<ArrayRef<QuantTensorSpec>>
Engine::Context::getOutputSpecs(AsyncValueRef<CompiledModels> compiledModels,
                                size_t modelIndex) {
  if (auto err = AsyncRT::awaitOrError(compiledModels))
    return err.takeError();

  if (auto model = compiledModels->getModel(modelIndex))
    return model->getOutputSpecs();

  return Error::getStaticString("model index out of bounds");
}

ErrorOr<ArrayRef<std::string>>
Engine::Context::getInputNames(AsyncValueRef<CompiledModels> compiledModels,
                               size_t modelIndex) {
  if (auto err = AsyncRT::awaitOrError(compiledModels))
    return err.takeError();

  if (auto model = compiledModels->getModel(modelIndex))
    return model->getInputNames();

  return Error::getStaticString("model index out of bounds");
}

ErrorOr<ArrayRef<std::string>>
Engine::Context::getOutputNames(AsyncValueRef<CompiledModels> compiledModels,
                                size_t modelIndex) {
  if (auto err = AsyncRT::awaitOrError(compiledModels))
    return err.takeError();

  if (auto model = compiledModels->getModel(modelIndex))
    return model->getOutputNames();

  return Error::getStaticString("model index out of bounds");
}

ErrorOr<std::vector<std::string>> Engine::Context::getKernelSummaries(
    const AsyncValueRef<CompiledModels> &compiledModels, size_t modelIndex) {
  if (auto err = AsyncRT::awaitOrError(compiledModels))
    return err.takeError();

  if (auto model = compiledModels->getModel(modelIndex))
    return model->getKernelSummaries();

  return Error::getStaticString("model index out of bounds");
}

ErrorOr<Engine::ConfiguredDevice>
Engine::Context::resolveDevice(M::DeviceRef deviceRef) const {
  for (auto &device : getConfig().getDevices())
    if (deviceRef == device.spec->ref)
      return device;
  return Error(Twine("unrecognized device '") + deviceRef.toString() + "'");
}
